articles.title: Magic: The Gathering Marvel: Darkhold Destiny Preorders Are Now Live
articles.summary: Magic: The Gathering's next Marvel crossover set has been revealed, as Wizards of the Coast announced that "Marvel: Darkhold Destiny" will launch on April 9, 2027. Preorders are now available via local game stores, TCGplayer, Amazon, and other retailers.
body: "The world's greatest sorcerers conspired to keep the Darkhold sealed," Wizards of the Coast (WOTC) said in its announcement, as part of New York Comic Con. "But the dark side of the Marvel Universe has been unleashed!"
It also teased the arrival of "devils, sorcerers, and vampire-hunting vampires" in the upcoming set, which will of course explore the supernatural side of Marvel.

An original story has been developed for the new set, with WOTC developing in collaboration with Marvel, which will also introduce a brand-new original character. The story will also be adapted into a special Marvel Comics release, written by Jackson Lanzing and Collin Kelly.
"This story was crafted by our Narrative team with Magic in mind, and we're thrilled to see it adapted by two of Marvel's most beloved writers," added WOTC.
points: Magic: The Gathering's next Marvel crossover set has been revealed, as Wizards of the Coast announced that "Marvel: Darkhold Destiny" will launch on April 9, 2027.
Preorders are now available via local game stores, TCGplayer, Amazon, and other retailers.

"But the dark side of the Marvel Universe has been unleashed!"

articles.title: Persona’s Horrifying Dong Monster Will Haunt My Nightmares Forever
articles.summary: Atlus’s Persona series of role-playing games incorporates a huge variety of mythological and folkloric creatures from around the world. Some are formidable warriors like Odin from Norse mythology or the Hindu goddess Lakshmi.
body: No, your eyes aren’t playing tricks on you. That is a giant, green penis with four arms, multiple tentacles, and a gaping mouth. He is a demon weiner, ribbed for your psychic displeasure. And yes, he’s riding a golden chariot. Mara is a Buddhist demon associated with temptation, lust, and earthly pleasures. The name is borrowed from Sanskrit, where it means "the Destroyer" or "the Evil One." It’s also a visual pun, because in Japanese “mara” is slang for “penis,” though he’s not depicted this way anywhere else in pop culture.

The tubular terror was slated to appear in 2024’s Metaphor ReFantazio, but was mercifully cut from the final version of the game, presumably to get that T for Teen ESRB rating. He has consistently been one of the most popular demons in the series, even claiming the number-one spot in an official 2017 Atlus poll.
points: Atlus’s Persona series of role-playing games incorporates a huge variety of mythological and folkloric creatures from around the world.
Some are formidable warriors like Odin from Norse mythology or the Hindu goddess Lakshmi.
That is a giant, green penis with four arms, multiple tentacles, and a gaping mouth.
He is a demon weiner, ribbed for your psychic displeasure.

articles.title: Halo officially returns in 2 weeks with new release
articles.summary: Bungie's bestselling military science fiction FPS, Halo, has spawned an impressive amount of content over the years since Halo: Combat Evolved was released for the Xbox in 2001. Debuting alongside Halo was the franchise's first tie-in novel, The Fall of the Reach, by Eric Nylund.
body: In addition to those more than 30 novels, there are graphic novels and, of course, more than a dozen Halo games to play. But if you still haven't had enough of the adventures of Master Chief on the ringworld, there's great news. On the horizon is Halo: Parasite’s Wake, the newest Halo novel from Gallery Books, written by New York Times-bestselling author, Tim Lebbon, which releases in two weeks, on October 20. Tim Lebbon is the award-winning author of dark fantasy, thriller, and horror novels such as The Silence as well as novelizations of films and other media series like Alien, Hellboy, and Firefly.

articles.title: What we've been playing - "It's pure video game popcorn movie stuff"
articles.summary: Hello and welcome back to our regular feature where we write a little about the games we've been playing. This week, Dom enjoys being back in Gears of War, which they should with a name like that; and Bertie ekes every last drop he can get out of The Blood of Dawnwalker before saving his family.
body: And don't forget we have an entire dusty archive of previous What We've Been Playings, just in case you don't trust your memory any more and want to check which games you've played, and see what you thought of them.

God, Horde Siege is good. Initially, I thought it was a bit too contrived compared to the very simple past version of the mode, that many people come to Gears for in the first place. But the open-ended maps, potential for cross-squad interplay and emergent moments... It's pure video game popcorn movie stuff. I assumed I'd play Gears for review then put it down, but with Siege... it's a good job there are no other big games coming out soon. Right? Right?!

I've got one day left before Brencis' coronation! In other words, I've got one day left to save my family before he presumably eats them as part of his dastardly plan to take over the world. To catch you up: I've already finished the game but I reloaded a save so I could see more of the world. And I've been stretching it out, trying to push into as many nooks and crannies as possible to see what else is out there.

articles.title: Avatar: Seven Havens's Biggest Plot Twist May Be Hiding in Plain Sight
articles.summary: Avatar: Seven Havens is a far more mystery-driven series than its predecessors, The Legend of Korra and Avatar: The Last Airbender. Avatar Korra supposedly caused a cataclysm that destroyed most of the world, but it’s unclear why she would do that and how the new Avatar might be able to fix things.
body: This article contains spoilers for the first episode of Avatar: Seven Havens.

In the series premiere, “On the Horizon,” Ellora — the Haven where this season takes place — celebrates a festival to mark its founding in the wake of the cataclysm. The actors in a play explaining the history are dressed in a rainbow of colors. Those colors also appear in charts of the seven chakras. An overhead image of Ellora shows the Haven of Wind and Sand appears to be made of red-hued rocks, the color associated with the root chakra. “The Root Chakra” is also the name of the season finale.

The Avatar franchise is based on Buddhist mysticism, following the cycle of reincarnation that Aang, Korra, and the new Avatars Pavi (Saheli Khan) and Nisha (Aishu Devan) are all part of. Series co-creators Michael Dante DiMartino and Bryan Konietzko previously dove into chakras as a meditation aid in the Avatar: The Last Airbender season 2 episode “The Guru,” when Guru Pathik trained Aang to cleanse blockages from his seven chakras in order to gain control over the Avatar State.
points: Avatar: Seven Havens is a far more mystery-driven series than its predecessors, The Legend of Korra and Avatar: The Last Airbender.
Avatar Korra supposedly caused a cataclysm that destroyed most of the world, but it’s unclear why she would do that and how the new Avatar might be able to fix things.

articles.title: 5 Brilliant Anime That Don’t Waste a Single Episode
articles.summary: Subjective taste inevitably plays a role here. A contemplative series like Mushi-shi and a sprawling space opera like Legend of the Galactic Heroes offer radically different versions of great storytelling.
body: Even the greatest anime usually have an episode or two that fans are tempted to skip during a rewatch. A select few, however, never let up. Every chapter advances the story, reveals something meaningful about its characters, or delivers an unforgettable display of animation.

The best anime balance compelling storytelling, striking visuals, and genuine thematic depth, but very few sustain that combination from beginning to end. Universally acclaimed series like Cowboy Bebop and Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood set an intimidating standard with their complex characters, carefully constructed worlds, and coherent themes. But plenty of less obvious choices come remarkably close to perfection.

The term “masterpiece” gets thrown around too easily, but it feels appropriate for Naoki Urasawa’s Monster. Madhouse’s 74-episode adaptation patiently unravels the manga’s philosophical mysteries without sacrificing the tension of its central game of cat and mouse.
points: A contemplative series like Mushi-shi and a sprawling space opera like Legend of the Galactic Heroes offer radically different versions of great storytelling.

articles.title: Magic: The Gathering Returns to Marvel with Darkhold Destiny
articles.summary: Magic: The Gathering and Marvel have already crossed over a couple of times with Spider-Man and the Marvel Super Heroes set last year. But for its third Marvel set, MTG is getting spooky with Darkhold Destiny.
body: Rather than being based in a fairly mundane version of New York, Darkhold Destiny is taking the likes of Doctor Strange and the Asgardians and telling a more magical story (forgive me). What really separates this new out-there set from the other two Marvel sets is that Wizards of the Coast was really able to write its own story with Marvel's characters and settings, which makes them feel less like a crossover and more like a part of Magic's multiverse.

With a new story written in-house, Wizards of the Coast was also able to give its artists more license to create their own takes on Marvel characters. For instance, with Scarlet Witch in the Marvel Super Heroes set, she looks like a pretty standard take on her comic book appearance. But in the art I was shown for Darkhold Destiny, she looks much more like an MTG character, while still retaining some of the signature parts of her outfit – the mask is still there.
points: Magic: The Gathering and Marvel have already crossed over a couple of times with Spider-Man and the Marvel Super Heroes set last year.

articles.title: Marvel Darkhold Destiny Is Magic: The Gathering’s First Universes Beyond Set Of 2027
articles.summary: Today at New York Comic Con, Wizards of the Coast announced the first 2027 Universes Beyond expansion set for Magic: The Gathering. Marvel’s Darkhold Destiny will pit Doctor Strange, Thor, Ghost Rider, and more against cosmic villains like Hela and Dormammu in 2027.
body: The set will include normal and Collector booster packs, and four pre-constructed commander decks themed around Marvel heroes and villains, including the Midnight Sons. Multiple cards were shown during the hour-long panel, including Magic, who transforms into Darkchild, Gargantos, and the titular Darkhold.

Darkhold Destiny tells an original story co-created by designers at Marvel and Wizards of the Coast. Along with that story, a brand-new character created for this set will be introduced in a Marvel Infinity comic series starting in February.

Mechanics include Vengeance, an Adventure-like gameplay feature that lets you cast spells from your graveyard and return the permanent it's attached to back to the battlefield, and the return of the Arcane subtype for spells.
Darkhold Destiny launches April 9 in big-box retailers and local game stores.

articles.title: GTA 6 Fan Says Rockstar Sent Them a Poster Just Because They Asked Nicely
articles.summary: A Grand Theft Auto 6 fan in Brazil said they politely asked the Rockstar Games team to send them a poster – and it looks like they actually followed through. Reddit user aogustoo shared their story in a post late last month.
body: "A while ago I took a complete shot in the dark and emailed Rockstar," they said. "I shared how hyped I was for GTA VI and asked if there was any chance I could get a poster for my room.

"Honestly, I expected an automated reply or nothing at all. To my absolute surprise, an executive actually answered and shipped an official GTA VI poster straight from their New York office to my home in Brazil."

You can see images, which show not only the poster but the emails they supposedly sent to receive it, above. As Rockstar (and the rest of the world) count down the days to GTA 6's November 19 launch, fans will no doubt be on the lookout for official merchandise like this. As many have pointed out, it's unclear if Rockstar truly took the time to send the poster, but the community is still looking to the moment as something worth celebrating as the countdown continues.

"This is a massive W tho," Rockstar content creator @videotech said on X/Twitter. "This guy isn’t an influencer or someone famous, literally just a random Rockstar fan. Very kind of Rockstar and Take-Two to take the time and effort to do this."
points: A Grand Theft Auto 6 fan in Brazil said they politely asked the Rockstar Games team to send them a poster – and it looks like they actually followed through.

articles.title: Let’s All Be Happy This AAA Minesweeper Game Isn’t Real
articles.summary: Minesweeper has been around for decades and it's probably overdue for some modern flourishes. Now there's a Triple-A Minesweeper parody that offers a hilarious look at what a Minesweeper update might look like.
body: The Triple-A Minesweeper was created by writer and programmer Mike Lacher, and it's fully playable as a browser game on his site. Aside from the intentionally pretentious title cards touting the involvement of Unreal Engine, Nvidia, Bink Video, and Wwise, Triple A Minesweeper looks and plays almost exactly like the regular Minesweeper.

However, the best way to enjoy this parody is by simply not doing anything at all. The main character, "Sweeper," will sit around and repeat things like, "I gotta sweep these mines," while receiving calls from newly created characters in the game. Lacher seems to have taken his inspiration from Grand Theft Auto 5, Metal Gear Solid, and even Cyberpunk 2077.

Among the callers are Nora, a potential love interest for Sweeper. Additionally, an underworld figure called The Don repeatedly calls for Sweeper to head down to his club while hinting at the latter's sinister past in Singapore. Meanwhile, the chipper DJ Dan celebrates Sweeper's efforts on behalf of New Dawn City.
points: Minesweeper has been around for decades and it's probably overdue for some modern flourishes.
Now there's a Triple-A Minesweeper parody that offers a hilarious look at what a Minesweeper update might look like.

articles.title: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation: I Played a New Slice from the Early Game With a Boss Fight | IGN Preview
articles.summary: While our earlier previews described a giant open-world game absolutely chock-full of activities, it was nice to see that the story-intense linear bits are still there, and just as dramatic as they were in the first two games.
body: We’re about six months out from Final Fantasy VII Revelation, and while that doesn’t seem like a huge wait, the anticipation to play the final chapter of the FF7 remake is palpable, especially since the first chapter dropped six(!) years ago now. We’ve also had the chance to go hands-on with Revelation before, and while the first couple previews were focused on flying around the open world in the Highwind, I got to play a much more linear slice at New York Comic Con.

My demo opened up early in Chapter 1, when the party arrives at the North Crater, and it starts a linear path to the center of the giant hole. In both of the previews we’ve done already, IGN’s Michael Higham and Logan Plant both described Final Fantasy VII Revelation as this massive and overwhelming experience, but this first chapter felt more like walking into a late-game dungeon to fight a massive boss.

Even my party members felt like late-game versions of themselves, fully decked out in Materia and equipment. But it’s important to keep in mind that this is just an early demo, so the balance could totally change before Revelation comes out in April.

articles.title: Call Of Duty: MW4 Early Access Also Includes DMZ, Here’s How To Get In
articles.summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's campaign is playable a week early for people who preorder, and now we know the DMZ mode will be as well. Activision has announced that MW4's extraction-based DMZ mode will be playable starting Tuesday, October 20, which is three days before the game launches.
body: To access DMZ mode before everyone else, you need to preorder any edition of MW4, including the standard or Vault versions. The perk applies to all platforms: PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Switch 2, and PC.

Described as the "definitive extraction shooter experience," DMZ in MW4 is an open-world game mode featuring other human players and AI combatants. Players will search the map for loot, craft gear, and complete objectives. Like in other extraction-based games, you need to reach the exfil point to make it out with all your rewards.

DMZ originally debuted with 2022's MW3 as a free-to-play beta inside Warzone, but this version left a lot to be desired. The new version of DMZ for MW4 seems like a big step up, and it includes a new social space this time as well.
For lots more, be sure to read up on GameSpot's previous coverage of the new version of DMZ.

articles.title: Gears Of War: E-Day–How’s It Selling? Let’s Unpack Things
articles.summary: Microsoft's latest console exclusive, Gears of War: E-Day, launched this week, and now we've gotten the first glimpse at how the game is performing commercially. Multiple analysts have weighed in, and there are numerous factors at play beyond pure sales, due to Game Pass and other factors.
body: Rhys Elliott of Alinea Analytics released a report that said the game has sold about 230,000 copies so far, with Steam sales accounting for 168,000 and Xbox (across console and PC) making up the other 62,000.

Straight sales do not tell the whole story, though, because E-Day is available on Game Pass, which Elliott said "cannibalized" the majority of sales. He said Alinea's data showed than 1.7 million people acquired E-Day through their Game Pass subscription as opposed to buying a copy outright.

There is more nuance there, too, as Elliott said that 722,000 of the 1.7 million people who played E-Day through Game Pass bought the $30 Premium upgrade, which got them in early and awarded them with extra content.

"So despite selling far fewer copies on Steam, Xbox accounts for almost three-quarters of the revenue (roughly $26 million of the $37 million, versus about $11 million on Steam). So '230,000 copies' undersells the paying audience. Including the 722,000 upgrades, nearly 950,000 people actually paid something for E-Day."

Not only that, I'm combining it with the fan I bought in summer to keep the air circulating. Reader, I don't mean to boast, but it dried two loads of washing including heavy ply towels overnight.
But enough about my successes, this is what the rest of the team are up to.

As the developers put it: "Thy wrists y-braced to a wan terminal of bone-whyte and tarnysshed latoun, þou steerest Ablahshikar by murke point-nettes and sputteryng tables." Ta to former RPS scribe and current Steam Hype editor Dominic Tarason for passing it on.

articles.summary: EA and Full Circle - the developer behind the new early access Skate game (skate.) - don't have a problem with modders and "creativity from players," but they're drawing the line with mods that aim to unlock paid microtransactions and unreleased content.
body: This comes just days after modding platform ReSkate blew up big time, reaching 350,000 downloads in mere hours. ReSkate essentially lets players experience the skating sim revival completely offline, unlike the online-only base game, with custom maps and cosmetics and servers.

"Like many of you, we've been following the launch of numerous mods for our game. Skateboarding in general is built on community and creative expression, and we support that. We love seeing your passion for pushing the limits of San Vansterdam in different ways. That’s why we built our new skateboarding sandbox in San Vansterdam to begin with, to give you, the players, the tools you need to have fun and create amazing content," a developer statement posted to Reddit and other online forums said.

videos.title: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort – Overview Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
videos.summary: The Nintendo Switch Sports Resort game launches October 22, 2026, exclusively on the Nintendo Switch 2 system. Pre-orders are available now:
body: The latest game in the intuitive sports series is coming to Nintendo Switch 2!
Get moving solo or with family and friends across 12 immersive sports. Aim for the target’s center in Archery, knock down pins in Bowling, duke it out in Boxing, and more!
You can also explore the island! Use Joy-Con 2 mouse controls in Skateboarding, steer across the waves in Power Cruising, and tilt the controller to fly around freely in Prop Plane.

videos.title: Forever Ago – Launch Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
videos.summary: Play Forever Ago now on Nintendo Switch 2:
body: Following a tragic stroke of fate, Alfred embarks on a journey north in search of redemption. In this single-player road trip adventure, you'll travel to beautiful places, capture memories with your camera, meet interesting characters, and even make some new friends.
